messages:
maria: Quick sweep of the new 'squeeze fusion' for fused-attn (epilogue + pack) vs current fused-attn on Flash variants. tl;dr: ~2.8-3.2x token throughput for seq<=64, ~10-12% regression for seq>=1024 on paged-KV workloads. Details below.

len: nice. which kernels did you compare?

maria: flash_v2_fused (baseline), flash_v2_fused_pack_biasrope (squeeze fusion impl), and paged_attn fallback. Ran on A100 80GB, mixed-precision FP16, batch size sweep 1..32, warmup 200 steps.

akshay: can you paste the perf table?

maria: sure, quick csv from the microbench run:
```
seq,batch,baseline_tok/s,squeeze_tok/s,delta
32,8,12000,35000,+191%
64,4,8000,24000,+200%
512,2,3000,2700,-10%
2048,1,850,740,-12%
```

maria: Profiler notes: higher L2 cache miss rate in the paged-KV path. flamegraphs show significant memcpy time in the epilogue when packing crosses page boundaries.

perf-bot: benchmark report uploaded: https://internal.perf/reports/3442109876 :bar_chart: (includes traces + hardware counters)

sasha: interesting. Is the regression specific to bias+rope fusion ordering?

maria: looks like bias+rope inlining increases stride in writeback for KV pages. When pack occurs pre-epilogue we write contiguous qkv but bias+rope introduces interleaved writes -> partial page writes + memcpy driven fallback. Repro cmd:
```
./runtest --model llama-7b --kernel squeeze_fusion --seq 2048 --batch 1 --kv-mode paged --profiling=trace
```

akshay: proposal: chooser policy that prefers squeeze fusion for seq<=128 or when paged_kv=false. Also add quick runtime fallback: if runtime profiler detects >15% memcpy time, switch to baseline fused kernel.

len: agree. also try merging epilogue write into page-aligned staging buffers to cut memcpy. Might be as simple as ensuring pack buffer is page-aligned and pre-sized.

maria: I opened a draft PR with the basic chooser rule + microbench: https://git.internal/r/redwood/prs/4823. Includes a microbench for page-aligned epilogue write.

akshay: safe rollout plan: canary 5% traffic for routes with avg_seq<128 and median cold_tokens<2k, collect epilogue_memcpy_ratio and token/s.

sasha: I'll add epilogue_memcpy_ratio to Console (per-route) and a regression alert if it exceeds 0.2 for 10m.

maria: next steps: (1) implement page-aligned write experiment, (2) add chooser heuristics + fallback, (3) canary and collect telemetry. Will post follow-up with flamegraphs and counter deltas. :eyes:

len: thanks for the quick sweep — looks promising for short-context workloads. keep us posted.
